tools.name: loopctl_ctg_prove
tools.description: prove: traverse it and write a proof receipt under data/proof-workflow/ Loop: ctg. Input: clean committed CTG mechanism and public carrier surfaces Writes: data/proof-workflow/ctg-<commit12>.json Exit: 0 traversal passed · 2 a mechanism step went red · 64 missing tool/context or invalid receipt state Exit codes are the target's own and are never re-mapped: 0 ok, 2 the loop's own check failed, 64 usage or a FATAL. Do not fold 2 and 64 together.

tools.name: loopctl_ctg_run
tools.description: run: execute the loop's real entry point Loop: ctg. Input: --packet: closed ctg-input@1.0.0 bundle manifest; --output: fresh absolute output directory Writes: <output>/ctg-route-result.json — ctg-route-result@1.0.0; <output>/code-truth-graph.json — content-addressed graph artifact Exit: 0 required reach stages passed · 2 a named measurement stage failed · 64 usage, closed-contract violation, or unverifiable input Exit codes are the target's own and are never re-mapped: 0 ok, 2 the loop's own check failed, 64 usage or a FATAL. Do not fold 2 and 64 together.

Do not fold 2 and 64 together.
